title: Isandro and the Veil
author: Orsen Nakamura
blurb: Ada Crane, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
